evals.prompt: Initialize djinn-ui in a Django project at /tmp/test-django with defaults and force flag, then verify djinn.json exists with registry_url __bundled__ and tailwind css set to static/css/djinn.css.
evals.expected_output: djinn.json exists at /tmp/test-django/djinn.json with registry_url '__bundled__' and tailwind.css 'static/css/djinn.css', templates/components/ directory created, theme/templatetags/djinn_tags.py exists
expectations: djinn.json is created with correct default values

evals.prompt: Add the button component to a djinn-initialized project using djinn add button --force, then verify both templates/components/button.html and theme/templatetags/djinn_button.py are created.
evals.expected_output: Both button.html and djinn_button.py are installed, djinn diff button reports [MATCH] for both files
expectations: djinn add button --force installs both files
djinn diff button reports MATCH for both files

evals.prompt: Run djinn doctor on an initialized project and verify it reports PASS for all checks (djinn.json exists, tailwind config, tailwind content includes templates, base CSS, cn tag, components directory).
evals.expected_output: djinn doctor exits 0 with all PASS checks

evals.prompt: Use djinn remove button --force to uninstall the button component, then verify both templates/components/button.html and theme/templatetags/djinn_button.py no longer exist.
evals.expected_output: Both button files are removed by djinn remove --force
expectations: djinn remove button --force removes both files

evals.prompt: Explain how to use cva() in a djinn component Python templatetag, including base, variants, default_variants, and how to handle the 'class' keyword since it's a Python keyword.
evals.expected_output: Clear explanation of cva() usage with base, variants, default_variants, and **{"class": "..."} pattern
